findings.issue: REG nonincrease is the pure-UP selection property, not a blanket property of the final Pack4 joint
findings.requested_change: 34 entries were selected on the UP-only prototype; subsequent Pack4 joint was recompiled and passed timing/quality. Do not transfer all prototype resource inequalities to the joint.

findings.issue: net paired timing cannot isolate added LDS/decode/STS/BAR costs from removed decoder benefits and spill/scheduling changes
findings.requested_change: State these concrete async candidates failed the three-resolution bidirectional promotion gate; identify added work as a cost hypothesis, not a measured component-wise dynamic inequality.

findings.issue: V3.8 static equivalence applies to its 500 added positive-zero folds relative to V3.1_pack5, not the entire migration relative to original native FP8 or FP32
findings.requested_change: Name the exact reference for the zero-fold proof. V4.0 27 direct checks use V3.8; tested V3.1 equivalence follows from same-input output hashes, not another 27 independent V3.1 comparison runs.

findings.issue: listed reopen conditions should not imply only NCU nonconversion bottlenecks or Host/ABI changes can reopen search
findings.requested_change: Also allow new high-priority candidate/evidence or independently reproducible gains within the same sealed boundary; the remaining finite subsets are acknowledged, not universally ruled out. No new experiment is required to close this stage.

findings.issue: 10.98675 and 10.995 ms are means of four process GPU medians per round, not a per-frame or per-process upper bound
findings.requested_change: Label the two-round paired means; the eight process medians span 10.920..11.022 ms.

findings.issue: acceptance.json approximate.reference stayed V3.1_pack5 in v39..v43
findings.requested_change: Correct explanatory reference metadata in a separate provenance-preserving maintenance change if desired; do not alter raw timing/output records. Actual runner args, candidate SHA and gold output checks identify the correct references.

findings.issue: original Host byte identity should not be confused with retaining the existing Ampere compatibility-patched Host/ABI across optimization rounds
findings.requested_change: Say no additional Host scheduling/weight/ABI changes relative to the sealed migration reference. Build scripts still apply historical architecture compatibility patches.

from pathlib import Path

a=read(36,'pack-range-audit.json');idx={k:i for i,k in enumerate(a['columns'])};rows=a['rows'];counts=collections.Counter(x[idx['kind']] for x in rows);z=[x for x in rows if x[idx['kind']]=='pack3'];assert len(rows)==8944 and all(counts[k]==n for k,n in a['counts'].items()) and len(z)==680;assert all(x[idx['interval']]==[0.,0.] and not x[idx['may_nan']] and x[idx['nonnegative_plus_zero_proved']] for x in z);byfb=collections.Counter(x[idx['FB']] for x in z);assert {str(k):v for k,v in byfb.items()}==read(37,'zero-fold-audit.json')['by_FB']

prim=[]
for v,n in [(36,'primitive-tests.json'),(36,'async-primitive.json'),(37,'zero-primitive.json'),(38,'zero-primitive.json'),(39,'up-primitive.json'),(40,'up-primitive.json'),(41,'up-primitive.json'),(42,'quad-primitive.json'),(43,'quad-primitive.json')]:

   if 'mismatch' in k and isinstance(x,(int,float)):assert x==0,(v,n,k,x)
 prim.append({'version':v,'artifact':n,'records':checks})
up39=read(39,'up-pair-audit.json');ix={k:i for i,k in enumerate(up39['columns'])};ur=up39['rows'];assert len(ur)==4744;pairs={(x[ix['FB']],x[ix['kernel']],x[ix['split_index']]) for x in ur};cross=[x for x in ur if x[ix['reason']]=='cross_block'];same=[x for x in ur if x[ix['eligible']]];assert len(pairs)==2372 and len(cross)==2062 and len(same)==2682

for x in cr:
 q=x[ix2['CFG_proof']];assert q['dominates'] and q['all_paths_unclobbered'] and not q['source_write_witnesses'] and not q['opaque_call_witnesses']
